title: Zone-Based Firewalls: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Picture an office with different security zones. Reception, the offices, and a vault. The rules apply when you move between them.

scenes.heading: Office security zones
scenes.narration: A zone based firewall groups interfaces into zones. Inside a zone, everyone moves freely by default. Between zones, everything is blocked until you say otherwise. A zone pair names the direction, such as inside to outside. A policy decides: inspect, drop or pass.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's stateful, unlike a plain list. Traffic within a zone is permitted. Pass forwards without tracking.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Zones group interfaces. Inside a zone is allowed, and between zones is denied. Inspect makes it stateful. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva firewalls lab.
